text: The standard warranty runs until 36 months or 30,000 km, whichever comes first, from the date of sale to the first owner. It carries over to each later owner for the balance of the remaining period. A later owner should inform the nearest Royal Enfield Service Centre about the purchase and fill in the form it asks for. Emission-related components have a separate emission warranty of 30,000 km or 3 years from first sale, whichever is earlier, in addition to the standard warranty. The evaporative emission control system has a different period, 24 months from first use, so confirm the cover for your bike with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre. The warranty applies to later owners only if all maintenance and services are done as the owner's manual schedule requires, within the warranty period or kilometre ranges, at a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer or Service Centre.
